title: Densities of top-dimensional currents with vanishing boundary mass and constant weak limit converge in L¹
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, n := d + 1, R > 0, c, Λ ∈ ℝ, U := B_{2R}(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ, Y_k ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) with u_k Lebesgue integrable on U, ∫_U|u_k| ≤ Λ for all sufficiently large k, and Y_k(ω) = ∫_U u_k(y)·ω(y)(e_0, …, e_d)dy for every k and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1). Assume M_U(∂Y_k) → 0 and Y_k(ω) → c∫_{ℝⁿ}ω(y)(e_0, …, e_d)dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then ∫_{B_R(0)}|u_k − c| → 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (R c Λ : ℝ) (Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (ball (0 : Euclid (d + 1)) (2 * R)) (d + 1)) (u : ℕ → Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ), 0 < R → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) (ball 0 (2 * R))) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), |u k y| ≤ Λ) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (ball (0 : Euclid (d + 1)) (2 * R)) (d + 1)), Y k ω = ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → Tendsto (fun k => (Y k).boundary.massOn (ball 0 (2 * R))) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (ball (0 : Euclid (d + 1)) (2 * R)) (d + 1), Tendsto (fun k => Y k ω) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in ball 0 R, |u k y - c|) atTop (𝓝 0)
